Create exactly three owls, ADULT MALE on left, ADULT FEMALE on right, one AGE-UNKNOWN MESOPTILE in foreground center. Warm tactile high-quality softly sculpted feather/painterly 3D natural-history game style, lovable round bodies but species-specific small short dark ear tufts, not generic wood owls. Humid Andean foothill broadleaf rainforest, mossy broad low tree fork, epiphytes, softly defocused lush greens, warm filtered daylight. NO bold horizontal zebra belly and no giant black teardrops. Adult folded wings end before tail tip, subtly barred tail.
